report_name: Cybersecurity Incident Disrupts U.S. Federal Bankruptcy Court Operations

threat_actors.name: Unknown Actor
threat_actors.description: The unidentified threat actor responsible for the cybersecurity incident at BAE Systems that disrupted the U.S. Federal Judiciary's Bankruptcy Noticing Center.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor targeted a third-party contractor, BAE Systems, to disrupt the services of the U.S. Federal Judiciary, exploiting the trusted relationship in a supply chain attack.

attack_patterns.name: Endpoint Denial of Service
attack_patterns.description: The cybersecurity incident resulted in the contractor taking the Bankruptcy Noticing Center (BNC) and its related websites offline, causing a nationwide disruption and denial of service for the federal bankruptcy court system.

identities.name: U.S. Federal Judiciary
identities.description: The U.S. government body whose bankruptcy court operations were disrupted due to a cybersecurity incident at its contractor, BAE Systems.

identities.name: Bankruptcy Noticing Center (BNC)
identities.description: A service operated by BAE Systems for the U.S. Federal Judiciary, which was taken offline, halting the production and distribution of all federal bankruptcy notices.

identities.name: BAE Systems
identities.description: A defense contractor for the U.S. Federal Judiciary that suffered a cybersecurity incident, leading to the disruption of the Bankruptcy Noticing Center (BNC).

identities.name: National Creditor Registration Service
identities.description: A public-facing service associated with the Bankruptcy Noticing Center that was rendered inaccessible due to the cybersecurity incident.

infrastructure.name: Bankruptcy Noticing Center (BNC) IT Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: The IT infrastructure supporting the BNC, operated by BAE Systems, which was taken offline to contain a cybersecurity threat.

infrastructure.name: Bankruptcy Noticing Center Website
infrastructure.description: The public-facing website for the BNC (bnc.uscourts.gov) which was taken offline as a result of the incident.

infrastructure.name: National Creditor Registration Service Website
infrastructure.description: A public-facing website associated with the BNC that was taken offline due to the incident.
